Name: Seaside Farm
Author: aldrichosaurusrex30
Description:
A modest Seaside Farm plus an additional cave and farm land.

Hello all! This is my first ever custom farm mod which hopefully isnt the last. 

~Changes the standard farm.
~You can't plant on the grass on the additional farmland but anywhere else on the main farm is tillable.
~You can only catch ocean fish here.
~Sprinkler friendly on the beach area.
~Extra cave acts like a greenhouse.
~Ducks swim in the lake and ocean waters.

Known issues: Greenhouse dirt tiles when moving it. 

If you have any concerns please feel free to leave a comment. Ill do my best to solve it thank you and enjoy the farm.
